summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed Form 6-K on July 13, 2026, disclosing a minor investment of US$78 thousand in Catalight Capital GP, L.P., alongside routine monthly operating results for June 2026. The investment represents about 0.30% of total assets and is a standard limited partnership interest acquisition with no stated price per share, premium, or special structural terms. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock involved. This filing does not trigger any special-situation category as it is a routine operational update and a de minimis investment, not a transformative event. What to watch: none.
